approved_scope.title: Pass safe.directory to SpecSync's isolated Git when the user's own Git trusts a repository owned by another user
approved_scope.description: Pass safe.directory to SpecSync's isolated Git when the user's own Git trusts a repository owned by another user
acceptance_criteria: (1) A repository owned by another user, which the user's global configuration lists in safe.directory, passes change audit, change status and change check as for its owner, including from a linked worktree. (2) Without that entry it is refused naming dubious ownership, the path and git config --global --add safe.directory. (3) A repository owned by the user keeps the global configuration off, as before. (4) safe.directory = * passes the repository's own top level, never *. (5) The file is owner-only, outside the project and its Git directory, and gone when the command ends.

answers.constraints: Reads stay isolated: GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM and the other strips stay; the global file holds only the safe.directory entry; the probe runs only after the isolated Git refuses for dubious ownership; never safe.directory=* or a repository-scoped value
